topic: What if you could pause everyone but you?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
PAUSE EVERYONE BUT YOU?

power.rule: everyone else freezes, you never pause yourself
power.look: a red PAUSE chip; a pulsing red freeze around everyone but you

script.text: See Mo about to wave. Pause — he's frozen, arm up. You slip past.
Pause mum. Grab the cookie she reaches for. Eat it alone.
Pause your friend. You catch him — still frozen.
What if you could pause everyone but you?

script.beat: 4 the turn: the cost, one real fact
script.text: One catch: to freeze someone, strip the heat — 21 megajoules. That's real. It's about to ruin your life.

science.claim: To freeze someone you must strip the heat out of them: about 21 megajoules per person.
science.working: A 70 kg person: body water is ~60% of the body = 42 kg. E = mcΔT + mL = 42×4.19×37 + 42×334 = 6.5e6 + 14.0e6 ≈ 20.5e6 J ≈ 21 MJ.
science.source: Physics: heat capacity of water 4.19 kJ/kg·K and latent heat of fusion 334 kJ/kg; body water ~60% of a 70 kg person.
